name: Friends And Friendship
overview: Scripture reveals that true friendship is marked by steadfast love and loyalty, especially in difficult times, as a friend loves at all times and a brother is born for adversity (Proverbs 17:17). Wise companionship leads to wisdom and life, while associating with fools results in destruction (Proverbs 13:20). Genuine friendship requires showing oneself friendly, and some friends are even closer than brothers (Proverbs 18:24). Conversely, forming close ties with angry or contentious individuals brings strife and separation among friends (Proverbs 16:28; 22:24), highlighting the importance of choosing friends who encourage righteousness and peace (Proverbs 12:26).
